retrospective_selection: All six remaining scheduled 2025 meetings after May 1. Previously exposed FOMC events, not a fresh holdout. Labels are stored separately and not loaded by the execution command.

archive.fetched_at_semantics: Evidence fetched_at records Common Crawl original capture, independently stated in the WARC-Date. Our retrieval time is recorded separately; no backdating of this run.

evidence_limit: One sparse archived policy statement; not a complete May 1 information set. No intervening outcomes or later evidence are added.
provider_policy: Parasail only, FP8 endpoint; provider fallbacks disabled, require_parameters true, max_price enforced, temperature 0. No retry after a terminal error. No served-weight attestation.
comparison: Both arms use the same caller-supplied authoritative event and typed-output draft prompt. Direct receives deterministic validation; harness additionally receives model review and at most one correction and re-review. No extraction call. Realized compute and dollars are not matched; report their differences.
stop: Runtime stops on uncertain/partial transport charges and authentication/rate-limit failures. No retries. Budget exhaustion prevents new calls. All planned rows remain in the report.
metrics: paired Brier difference and issued-only log loss
all-case Brier bounds for missing forecasts
inference_limits: Only one correlated policy-year cluster; no meaningful confidence interval, calibration estimate, independent replication, or 9/10 claim. No tuning or replacement after exposure.
ai_disclosure: AI-assisted protocol, extraction, execution and analysis; not independent human review.
post_repair_interpretation: New model/provider and repaired parser; not a causal estimate of the parser intervention. Prior 12B study is immutable. Same exposed six-event development sample. Direct versus harness comparison is paired within this new run.
reproduction: Use run.mts without --run for a no-spend registration check. For an independent paid replication, preserve the original manifest and protocol, create a separately named registration with your own starting ledger hash and budget, and obtain explicit spending authorization. Runtime ledger is private, append-only in accounting, and reused across both Gemma runs.
